Natsume to release new Harvest Moon: Seeds of Memories. Coming for Wii U, PC, Android, and iOS.

I wish I was still interested in the series, but I feel like the last good iteration was Magical Melody. The few I played after were just not up to par. Plus now that Natsume is making their own games under the "Harvest Moon" moniker, rather than localizing the originals from Japan, it's debatable on whether you would call this a true Harvest Moon game.

That being said, I am totally open to either Natsume or Marvelous Entertainment coming out with a decent farming sim game. I just won't be holding my breath.

The issue with the "Harvest Moon" franchise being split is that Natsume owns the naming rights to Harvest Moon, and Marvelous now owns the license to translate and publish the Bokujou Monogatari game series (which was previously licensed in North America as Harvest Moon under Natsume, and is now licensed as Story of Seasons).

So is this game a Harvest Moon game? Technically, yes. Is it a Bokujou Monogatari game? Most definitely not. Will it be good? We'll have to wait and see on that one.
